exam_rules: Closed-book. Pearson VUE online proctored or in-person. No notes or reference materials. Score reported on scale of 1–350; passing is 245.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID. Name must match registration.

lifecycle.summary: F5's live exam catalogue lists the 302 exam as bookable: 'BIG-IP DNS Specialist (302) - BIG-IP - CERTIFICATION EXAM - F5-CTS, BIG-IP DNS - See Complete Information - Schedule Now', alongside 201, 202, 301a, 301b and 303. F5's certification programme is running ('F5 Certified exams are developed to deliver consistently reproducible results that validate the expertise of those who achieve certification'), with a live Candidate Portal.

official_study_resources.notes: Official study guides available for each certification
official_study_resources.title: F5 Certification Exam Study Guides

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 3 years. Renew by passing the current exam or a higher-level exam.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period. Full exam fee for retake.

testing_centers.notes: Online proctored or in-person via Pearson VUE.
